title: Observation frame (interface v0, DRAFT)
description: One record per image frame, handed by the robot or any stand-in for it (emulator, handheld camera, cart) to the disease system. Minimal contract of H8 section 4 piece 1 / H6 E12; the full O&M/SensorThings model of G4 section 2.3 comes later. Status: W1 draft, not yet reviewed with the robotics side.

frame.description: The image. Same object as 'frame' in the model-service request (H8 section 6.2).

frame_uid.description: Identifier of this image frame. Named frame_uid, not frame_id: in ROS frame_id names a coordinate frame, as metadata.pose.frame_id does here (hand-shake with piece 4, 2026-09-19).

uri.description: Where the image bytes are: mcap://<bag>/<topic>/<seq> or a file path (H8 section 6.2). Exact forms are fixed with piece 2 (MCAP replay, W3).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the image bytes exactly as stored at uri (the encoded image file, or the MCAP message data), lowercase hex.

metadata.description: Where, when and how the frame was taken. All fields are mandatory; a nullable field must still be present, with null.

site_id.description: Site: farm, ZUT field, lab, or a virtual site built from an open dataset (e.g. MAK-Luwero).

zone_id.description: Zone within the site layout (G4 section 3.3: full-sun control, inter-row, under-panel). Reserved value: 'open' (no panel).

timestamp_utc.description: Acquisition (exposure) time of the frame, not ingest time. RFC 3339 in UTC with 'Z', up to nanoseconds.

pose.description: Pose of the camera at exposure. Metres and radians (ROS REP 103).

yaw.description: Heading, radians, counter-clockwise about z from the x axis of frame_id, in [-pi, pi].

frame_id.description: Coordinate frame the pose is expressed in (ROS TF frame name), e.g. 'plot'.

model.description: Camera model; for open datasets, the capture device as far as known.

exposure_us.description: Exposure time, microseconds; null when the source does not record it.

gain.description: Sensor gain; null when not recorded. Unit not fixed in v0 (open question).

flash.description: Whether the flash fired for this frame.

white_balance.description: White-balance mode or setting as reported by the camera, e.g. 'auto'.

sowing_batch.description: Sowing batch of the plot. Reserved value: 'unknown' (e.g. open datasets).

bbch.description: BBCH growth stage of the plot, 0-99; null only together with bbch_null_reason.

bbch_null_reason.description: Why bbch is null; required when bbch is null, not allowed otherwise. not_recorded: nobody assessed it; not_applicable: no crop stage applies (e.g. colour target, bare soil); unknown: assessed but could not be determined.

id.description: Identifier: letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; starts with a letter or digit; at most 128 characters; no spaces, slashes or colons.
